ev.q: In 2020, age-adjusted suicide rates among females increased as the level of urbanization declined, from 4.6 per 100,000 population in large central metropolitan areas to 7.1 in small metropolitan areas
age-adjusted suicide rates among females increased as the level of urbanization declined
Rates among males were lowest in large central areas (16.9) and increased as the level of urbanization declined to 33.7 in noncore areas.
Males had higher death rates than females for each corresponding urbanization level.
Age-adjusted suicide rates are per 100,000 standard population; 95% CIs are indicated by error bars.
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data, 2020.

methods_quotes.q: Age-adjusted suicide rates are per 100,000 standard population; 95% CIs are indicated by error bars.
Urbanization level is based on county of residence using the National Center for Health Statistics Urban-Rural Classification Scheme for Counties.
